fields.title: A failed word count or a jump never loses or overwrites the reader's page
fields.description: When bookWords cannot arrive, a held Page turn saves its cfi with the stored position kept (update-doc-progress keeps position on -1); every jump (TOC, Jump back, restore, word click, internal link, open without cfi) cancels a held turn; failed-replay diagnostic.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-15 by Blurby.Roadmap on Blurby.Brain's ruling (Rule 11 tier 1). Release gate (10). From PAGE-SAVE-RESTAMP-GUARD-1's quality review (findings 1, 3, 4). Before PAGE-POSITION-SAVE-2. Full Spec: U9/U10 pass.
